summary: One headless Claude SU subject (su-9a55174e-ca63-434f-af99-fd3810e4f8c1, adv session 31503, fleet r7-journey-0927) was launched on :3170 build 0808a7b4fe wearing the default SU composition plus the installed papercusp-engineer 0.1.2 specialization. The CLI and GUI pickers both offer SU first and by default over the paginated catalog, keeping invalid and ineligible identities visible with reasons. Mode attach and detach applied live in the same native. Peer coupling reached the subject's orientation. Warm respawn, cold fork and --resume re-rendered only live values (the INSTRUCTION-PRECEDENCE observedAt and watermark); every package, layer, compiler, source and configuration pin stayed fixed across all 6 identity entries. In every native, the pinned prompt-file hash equals the sha256 of the delivered systemPrompt[0]. Activation acknowledgment followed native emission for every injected generation. All links passed.

scripts/verify-tauri-headless.sh booted papercusp-desktop on its own Xvfb display and drove the launcher Identity combobox in the real webview (2026-09-29T22:18:30.541Z -> 2026-09-29T22:18:46.871Z). The default input reads 'SU' and SU is the first option. The catalog loaded in 3 pages and rendered 23 of 23 expected options, with none missing or extra. Invalid and ineligible identities stay visible with a reason (true/true), and no disabled option lacks one. The first attempt exited 1 on an esbuild bundling error from a peer's in-progress rename in the shared tree (l7-verify-tauri-attempt1.log). The retry passed.

The subject's activation rows were joined to the CTRL hook-context lines in its own native transcripts (5275a509, cede7e01, 8d715525, 3184c0b8). For generations 3, 5, 8, prepared < native emission < applied, and the applied row names the native that received the emission. Generations 7 and 12 are relaunch paths (warm respawn, --resume): the new native started on the re-rendered spec, its applied row is the acknowledgment, and the CTRL line follows it. Generation 2 was emitted at launch (line 8), then superseded by generation 3 before an acknowledgment turn: it has a prepared row and no applied row. Generations 10, 13 changed control state only (loop/carry), emitted CTRL and wrote no activation rows. No generation reports applied without a prior emission, and no ordering violation exists.

Abstract-component discoverability was observed only in the launcher catalog: mode components and practice:su.practice are listed as disabled with reasons.
The CLI evidence runs the launcher's real row builder over the live catalog. It is not an interactive TTY picker session; the subject itself was launched with --no-picker.
R-6 goal kickoff/portfolio/obligation composers and R-7 SU fleet/goal holder replacement were not exercised in J1F. Rollback and deployed pins are J3 (WI-10003584). The generic non-SU identity is J2.

The resumed conversation (8d715525 after --resume) recorded no new prompt_snapshot, and its self-report (P008_J1F_R_RESUMED_REPORT) still names the pre-resume watermark 9c92de5f. The resumed process's argv carried the refreshed file, but its effective system prompt is not observable from the transcript. The refreshed render is proven by the file hash and by the next native (3184c0b8).
Generation 2 was emitted but superseded by generation 3 before an acknowledgment turn, so it has no applied row. The launch render is proven by the prompt join, not by a generation-2 applied row.
Generations 7 (warm respawn) and 12 (--resume) are relaunch paths, not control injections: the applied row precedes the first transcript CTRL line in the new native.
Generations 4 and 6 (couple/decouple) have no CTRL hook-context line and no activation rows; the subject read them through coord:orient.

Cold forks receive their carry through the COLD LOOP WAKE loop-fire prompt. 8d715525's second systemPrompt part (a carry document) is inherited from its warm-respawned parent; 3184c0b8, forked from the resumed process, has one part.
L7 ran the desktop shell from the shared working tree, not from build 0808a7b4fe. Its SPA snapshot was frozen at boot; the drift banner listed only docs HTML changes.
